name: 奇域空间(Wonderland Space)
detailed_description:
Game Description:

  • Entering 'Wonderland Space', a fantastic adventure that crosses dimensions begins! You will transform into a traveler traveling through time and space, encountering mysterious mechanisms by the shimmering pool, jumping into the abyss of dreams to uncover the secrets of your subconscious; Strolling through the old streets and alleys of 90s China, the old TV in the living room is playing our favorite cartoons from childhood. On the table are elementary school Chinese textbooks - "Who is the cutest person", "The Five Heroes of Langya Mountain", "The Golden Fish Hook", the classic memory of the Little Overlord card insertion arcade game, DVD discs, and BB machines Amidst the interplay of bluestone slabs and mottled brick walls, there is a nostalgic sentiment, and hidden in the hustle and bustle of the city are the dusty mysteries of the past.

  • Turning around and stepping into the unique Dunhuang culture of Gansu, China, stepping into the millennium murals of Dunhuang, flying ribbons and magnificent cofferdams flow at your fingertips, unlocking the code of ancient civilization; Crossing the futuristic city shrouded in neon lights, neon light effects and mechanical structures construct science fiction wonders, rewriting fate in the flow of data and machinery.

  • When retro and future collide, reality and dreams intertwine, each scene is a carefully crafted immersive world, and every story hides mysteries! Explore hidden Easter eggs, unlock cross temporal linkage plot, use your wisdom and courage to write your own legend in the intertwining of virtual and real time cracks! Come and embark on this wonderful journey of breaking through the dimensional wall!

  • This is a special statement from the developer to the player:

Welcome to purchase, download, and play the game. All experiences can be described in the comments section. This version is only the first development version and was developed by the author himself. If you have any innovative gameplay/ideas or more optimization suggestions/opinions for the game, please feel free to share them in the comments section. I will work hard to update and optimize the game according to each player's true thoughts, and welcome every player who is willing to come here. There are more gameplay and new experiences constantly being updated. Thank you very much for your support of this work!

In addition, you can also join the group chat to share more innovative gameplay ideas about this game genre. Welcome to join the Qiyu Space game experience feedback QQ communication group: 773911082

Experience this mysterious game in different environments...
